svg.aria-label: Levels of evidence for the function of a non-coding RNA: from confirmed transcription through correlation, conservation, a deletion experiment, rescue by supplying the RNA from another location, to identification of the binding partner; the distinction between the locus being required and the RNA molecule being functional; and why a cis-acting RNA does not pass the rescue test.
svg.text: A Six levels, from weakest to strongest
1 it is transcribed
transcription happens; function unknown
2 expression correlates with a condition
correlation; cause unknown
3 the sequence is conserved
possibly under selection
4 deleting it changes the phenotype
the LOCUS is required
5 supplying the RNA elsewhere rescues it
the RNA MOLECULE functions (trans)
6 binding partner and segment identified
the molecular mechanism is established
B Why levels 4 and 5 must be separated
lncRNA
enhancer
Deleting the locus may have removed an enhancer as well, or the
FUNCTION may have been the act of transcription (mode 4 in section 6).
Level 5 is what tells the two apart.
The rescue test
rescued to the RNA molecule works
not rescued to the DNA at that place,
or the act of transcribing it, works
A caution from section 7
A cis-acting RNA such as Xist CANNOT
pass the rescue test — supplied elsewhere
it does not act. So use this ladder to tell
WHAT functions, not as a pass/fail for function.
The habit this unit asks for
A mark measured is not a mark that caused.
A factor bound is not a factor that changed
transcription.
Do not convert correlation into mechanism,
or mechanism into cause, in one step.
